name: webtransport-loopback-baseline
purpose: Measure loopback WebTransport over HTTP/3 as a direct-path candidate reference
steps: Generate an ephemeral local TLS certificate and DER hash
Start a loopback QUIC endpoint and accept WebTransport sessions
Exchange bounded binary control messages on bidirectional streams
Disconnect the client and establish a fresh WebTransport session
Write the raw result before generating the report
